jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Job Overview

Lead client technology projects from kickoff through delivery, managing scope, schedules, budgets, and risks while coordinating teams and keeping clients informed.

About Simplify IA, LLC

Simplify IA is a leader in intelligent automation, AI, and digital transformation, combining cutting-edge technologies with expert consulting to help organizations streamline operations, elevate customer and employee experiences, and accelerate innovation

Description

Essential responsibilities

* Translate statements of work into delivery plans with milestones, owners, dependencies, budgets, and acceptance criteria.
* Manage scope, schedules, resources, risks, and issues; secure approval for changes and escalate delivery concerns promptly.
* Keep clients and internal leaders informed through accurate status reporting, decisions, forecasts, and follow-through.
* Coordinate onshore and offshore contributors with Business Analysts and Technical Leads, who retain functional and technical ownership.
* Facilitate planning, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and client meetings; coordinate testing, acceptance, training, and launch readiness.
* Arrange documented handoffs to the dedicated support team and clarify post-launch responsibilities and support scope.
* Improve delivery practices, mentor colleagues, and partner with Sales when client needs create additional opportunities.

Required qualifications

* Substantial technology project-management experience, typically about 10 years; comparable demonstrated experience will be considered.
* A record of delivering software implementations or application-development projects with accountability for scope, budget, schedule, and results.
* Experience coordinating distributed teams and managing several concurrent engagements.
* Clear written and verbal communication with technical teams, clients, and executives.

Preferred qualifications

Consulting or utility-industry experience; familiarity with Appian or other low-code platforms; PMP, Scrum, or a comparable certification.

Success in this role

Clients understand delivery status, risks surface early, commitments and changes are controlled, and accepted solutions transition smoothly to support.

How we work

We earn trust by owning our commitments, supporting our clients and colleagues, bringing care and expertise to our work, and solving problems together.

This role is remote within the United States. Travel is required as needed for client meetings, workshops, and delivery milestones. Work includes online collaboration and presentations; specific travel and scheduling needs are discussed during hiring.

Benefits

* Medical, dental, and vision: 100% company-paid employee-only premiums.
* Life insurance: Company-paid basic group coverage.
* Disability insurance: Company-paid short-term and long-term coverage.
* Retirement: 401(k) with a company match of up to 4% of eligible pay.
* Flexible Time Off: 160 hours annually, prorated for new hires.
* Holidays: 11 paid company holidays, generally totaling 88 hours annually.
* Other leave: Paid bereavement, voting, and other leave under policy and law.
* Remote work: Up to $2,000 annually in eligible expense reimbursements.
* Business expenses: Reimbursement under company policy and applicable law.

Benefits are subject to eligibility and governing plan terms. The 401(k) match depends on employee contributions. Remote-work reimbursements require eligible, documented expenses and are subject to a 60-day waiting period and new-hire proration. Statutory sick and safe leave and other required leave and reimbursements are provided regardless of policy limits.

Equal opportunity and accommodations

Simplify IA, LLC is an equal opportunity employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, sex, pregnancy or related conditions, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, genetic information, marital or family status, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Essential functions may be performed with or without reasonable accommodation. We provide accommodations for disabilities, religious beliefs or practices, and pregnancy-related needs as required by law. Contact hr@simplifyia.com for an accommodation or an accessible application method. We prohibit unlawful discrimination, harassment, and retaliation.

How to apply

U.S.-based W-2 employees only. Applicants must work in the United States and be authorized to work here. No 1099 independent-contractor or corp-to-corp arrangements are available. Employment visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

This description summarizes the role and does not create an employment contract. Related duties may evolve with business needs, consistent with applicable law.

Salary

$130,000 - $150,000 per year

Pay: $130,000.00 - $150,000.00 per year

jobs.title: Project Controls & QA/QC Project Manager - EV Charging Programs
jobs.description:
**Company Description**

Turner & Townsend is a global professional services company with over 22,000 people in more than 60 countries.

Working with our clients across real estate, infrastructure, energy and natural resources, we transform together delivering outcomes that improve people’s lives. Working in partnership makes it possible to deliver the world’s most impactful projects and programs as we turn challenge into opportunity and complexity into success.

Our capabilities include program, project, cost, asset and commercial management, controls and performance, procurement and supply chain, net zero and digital solutions.

We are majority-owned by CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, with our partners holding a significant minority interest. Turner & Townsend and CBRE work together to provide clients with the premier program, project and cost management offering in markets around the world.

 **Job Description**

Turner & Townsend is seeking a detail-driven **Project Controls & QA/QC PM** with 5+ years of experience to support a fast-growing EV charging program for a leading autonomous vehicle client. The program develops fleet charging depots with third-party charging partners under a Charging-as-a-Service (CHaaS) model, with an active pipeline across USA, EMEA and APAC.

You will be the quality and control backbone of a regional delivery team. You will own the program's trackers, reporting and workflow discipline, and run first-line quality checks on feasibility reviews, project charters and partner submissions before they reach leadership. This role suits someone who enjoys bringing order to a high-volume pipeline, catches what others miss, and wants to grow toward program management in EV infrastructure.

**Responsibilities**

Quality assurance and quality control

* Run first-line QC on feasibility reviews and project charters
* Verify completeness and consistency: site data, charger details, electrical service etc
* Validate deliverables against client standards; track issues to closure.
* Build, maintain and version-control QC checklists, templates and document standards.
* Track QC metrics and report on trends.

Project controls and reporting

* Own the program pipeline tracker and single source of truth for sites across all stages.
* Produce weekly and monthly program reporting
* Monitor SLA performance; flag aging items and bottlenecks early.
* Maintain intake logs, including ad-hoc sites outside the formal pipeline

Systems and reporting

* Maintain the program's reports and dashboards in Smartsheet (or future platforms).
* Develop standards and short user guides so Regional PMs enter data consistently.
* Act as first point of contact for PM tool questions

Program operations

* Manage project intake screening and keep project records complete.
* Capture meeting decisions and track action items.
* Maintain site tour logs and consolidate PM feedback from site visits.
* Coordinate document control across the client, charging partners and internal teams.

Continuous improvement

* Identify repetitive manual work and seek out automation opportunities.
* Support the Team Lead on process, playbook and tooling improvements
* Provide support to Regional PMs on routine deliverables during peak periods.
* Adhere to SOX control responsibilities where applicable.

  
**Qualifications**

**Required:**

* Bachelor's degree in construction management, engineering, architecture or a related field, OR equivalent experience.
* If you live in/near San Francisco, CA, you should be able to be onsite 3 days a week.
* 5+ years in project controls, QA/QC, project coordination or assistant project management on capital, real estate or infrastructure programs.
* Experience supporting construction of service centers, transportation hubs, or infrastructure-heavy facilities.
* Familiarity with permitting and utility coordination processes.
* Strong organizational and communication skills.
* Proficiency in Google workspace, and project management tools (e.g., Smartsheet or Sitetracker).
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and adapt to changing project needs.
* Comfortable working in both field and office settings, with occasional travel as needed.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to manage documentation across multiple projects.
* Knowledge of EV systems, charging infrastructure, or fleet operations is beneficial.
* Proven experience reviewing technical documents for completeness and accuracy against standards or checklists.

**Preferred:**

* Exposure to EV charging infrastructure, fleet depots, utility coordination or permitting.
* Experience with multi-party delivery models (developer, partner or owner's rep).
* Lean, Six Sigma or similar process-improvement training.

 **Additional Information**

**The salary range for this full-time role is** **$120K-$130K** **per year.** Ranges are determined by role and level and represent a good faith effort to provide a fair and equitable salary. This range is a reflection of base salary only, not of a total compensation package. Please note Turner & Townsend reserves the right to pay more or less than the posted range, depending on candidate’s experience and qualifications.

* ***On-site presence and requirements may change depending on our client's needs.***

  
Our inspired people share our vision and mission. We provide a great place to work, where each person has the opportunity and voice to affect change.

We want our people to succeed both in work and life. To support this we promote a healthy, productive and flexible working environment that respects work-life balance.

Turner & Townsend is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and actively encourage applications from all sectors of the community.

Please find out more about us at www.turnerandtownsend.com/ and https://www.heery.com/

Trilogy Federal drives innovative solutions for complex business challenges across financial management, healthcare, and government industries. Our collaborative, client-first service approach, combined with our commitment to the rapid implementation of pragmatic solutions, has earned Trilogy an unparalleled reputation for delivering transformative results.

We are seeking an experienced **Program Manager** for a new part-time opportunity with an existing federal customer. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of experience with federal accounting or federal financial audit, which is essential to the successful performance of the program. The chosen candidate will join a skilled team of professionals dedicated to our client’s compliance with established accounting, financial management and reporting requirements. Our team provides expert technical accounting services including SFFAS and Treasury financial management policy monitoring, development of accounting policies, procedures and process documentation, collaboration with subject matter experts to develop financial data visualizations and dashboards, developing presentations, white papers and graphic design support related to financial reporting.

This position may also involve business development support, such as proposal development and other capture activities, as assigned.

This position is 100% remote and part-time/hourly with an estimated average of 20 –25 hours per week (~ 20 hours supporting client engagement, with additional hours for business development as authorized).

### **Primary Responsibilities:**

* Develop and maintain project management documents including Project Management Plan, Project Schedule, Weekly Status Reports, Quality Assurance and Quality Control, among others.

* Manage all work performed under the contract, overseeing the staff and the subject matter experts that support the program.

* Develop documentation templates and protocols

* Lead executive level meetings

* Perform and oversee performance of accounting research

* Develop presentations for client management

* Develop policy and procedure templates and repository

* Develop and oversee development of new or update accounting policies, procedures and process maps

* Perform walk-through interviews of process owners

* Design financial management dashboard(s) – identifying content and working with SMEs to develop.

* Design presentation templates and graphic design tools and guidance

* Develop training

### **Minimum Requirements:**

* Bachelors degree in Accounting

* Minimum of 8 years of federal accounting or federal financial statement audit experience.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

* The ability to obtain a Public Trust clearance.

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* CPA, CGFM or PMP is a plus.

$80 - $85 an hour

* Certified Public Accountant (CPA) preferred.

$140,000 - $160,000 a year

jobs.title: Hardware Deployment Project Manager
jobs.description:
**About Gather AI**  
Are you ready to build the future of supply chain? At Gather AI, we're not just creating software; we're pioneering a new era of warehouse intelligence. We've developed a groundbreaking, vision-powered platform that uses autonomous drones and existing equipment to capture real-time data, completely digitizing workflows that have historically been manual and error-prone. This means facilities operate smarter, safer, and more efficiently, ultimately redefining "on-time, in full" delivery.  
If you're looking for an opportunity to contribute to truly transformative technology and make a significant impact in a vital industry, Gather AI is the place for you. We're leading the charge in the rapidly evolving robotics industry, and we invite you to join us in reshaping the global supply chain, one intelligent warehouse at a time.  
**About the Team**  
Gather AI's Hardware team designs, builds and supports the hardware behind our platform: autonomous inventory drones and camera systems that mount on customers' material handling equipment (MHE). The team includes hardware engineers and technicians who work out of the Pittsburgh HQ. Hardware designs and builds new product implementations, reviews and repairs RMAs, and performs detailed analysis of field failures while Field Ops runs day-to-day customer site support.  
**About the role**  
Our robots are already working in customer warehouses, and every new deployment depends on the right hardware arriving built, configured and ready. In this role, you'll own the hardware side of that: deployment readiness, field hardware escalations and returns, and accurate documentation of deployment configurations and bill of materials (BOMs) across Hardware programs. This is an ownership role and much of the processes behind it are yours to build collaboratively with Hardware leadership. As our Hardware Deployment & Development Coordinator, you'll be the hardware team's hub between development and field operations: making sure each deployment's hardware is ready on time, owning how we handle field hardware issues and returns, and keeping our bills of materials and fleet configurations accurate across all our hardware programs. You'll report to our Director of Hardware and work closely with engineers, technicians, Field Ops, Purchasing and customer implementation teams.  
**What you'll do**

* Own hardware readiness for each customer deployment: build schedules, kit lists, parts status, shipping and site prerequisites.
* Be on site for installs and go-lives as the hardware liaison lead, then hand off cleanly to Field Ops.
* Own tier-2 hardware escalations: triage, route to the right technician or engineer, and close the loop.
* Own our RMA process: intake, disposition, failure analysis coordination and trend reporting back to engineering and suppliers.
* Own BOM accuracy and configuration management across programs, including revision control and serial/config traceability.
* Build and document the processes behind the work, including the readiness checklist, RMA workflow and configuration control.
* Plan development builds and test assets with engineering and the technicians, and turn field findings into engineering action.
* Coordinate development builds, test assets and technician schedules, and turn field findings into engineering action.
* Give Purchasing a clear demand plan and flag long-lead and single-source risks early.

**What you bring**

* You've owned hardware readiness for deployments, production launches or NPI builds end to end —, covering schedules, kits, parts and handoffs — and kept other teams moving toward the date without direct authority.
* You've owned the record of what hardware is built and implemented: BOMs and revisions, configurations and change control, or RMA processes. Ideally you've build one of these, not just owned it.a BOM or configuration record, an inventory system or an RMA process.
* You can read assembly and part drawings, electrical schematics, and understand critical to quality callouts. drawings and harness pinouts, and you're comfortable getting hands-on to troubleshoot hardware.
* You can take a field escalation from first report to resolution and keep everyone informed along the way.
* You're detail-oriented, agile and adaptable and adapt quickly when plans change.

**Nice to have**

* Experience in warehouse, material handling or forklift environments.
* Robotics or autonomous-vehicle deployment experience.
* Experience working with suppliers or contract manufacturers on ECOs or recurring defects.Experience coordinating with suppliers or contract manufacturers.
* Experience with Document Control, Good Documentation Practices, and Good Manufacturing Practices.

**Location** Pittsburgh, PA (on site) or remote in the US. About one week a month on site in Pittsburgh; when a customer deployment is active, travel to that site takes priority. Eastern time zone is a plus.  
**How we hire** A recruiter conversation, a conversation with the hiring manager, a practical deployment-planning exercise, and a final round with the team. We'll tell you before each step whether AI tools are welcome.

jobs.title: Associate Data Analyst
jobs.description:
**Company Description**

**Redica Systems** is the Intelligence Cloud for life sciences, transforming regulatory complexity into connected, proactive intelligence. Redica's platform helps the world's leading Pharmaceutical and MedTech companies stay inspection-ready, manage supplier risk, and keep pace with evolving global regulations. Built on the Redica Catalyst Platform and powered by Redica ID, Redica unifies the industry's most complete regulatory and inspection datasets, sourced from hundreds of global health authorities, into trusted intelligence for quality and regulatory teams. The Redica Intelligence Cloud brings data together to anticipate risk, accelerate compliance, and enable smarter, faster decisions across the enterprise.

More information is available at redica.com.

 **Job Description**

Redica Systems is looking for an Associate Data Analyst to develop customer-facing reports and dashboards using our regulatory intelligence data.

You'll translate customer requests into clear reporting requirements, work with data covering inspections, observations, warning letters, and enforcement actions, and present findings through dashboards, executive reports, and compelling data storytelling.

We're looking for someone who's analytical, detail-oriented, and comfortable using AI to improve how they work. Just as important is a practical, down-to-earth approach and the ability to communicate clearly with customers and colleagues.

**Core Responsibilities**

* Translate customer reporting requests into precise, scoped queries using Redica tools, including Sigma, Claude, and Redica MCP, to identify and extract the right underlying data.
* Build, customize, and publish customer-facing reports, including workbooks, data elements, and visualizations tailored to each customer’s needs.
* Own the full report lifecycle, from intake and data identification through build, QA, proofing, and delivery.
* Interpret and validate data outputs for accuracy before any customer-facing delivery. This is not a “pull and send” role; judgment about data quality and relevance is required.
* Navigate regulatory intelligence data, including FDA enforcement actions, Form 483 observations, warning letters, and inspection records, to answer customer-specific questions through structured reporting.
* Manage multiple concurrent customer deliverables with accuracy and on-time delivery.

**About You**

* **Business Insight:** You understand customer reporting needs and how accurate regulatory intelligence data helps customers answer business-critical questions. You can connect data outputs to the customer’s underlying need, not just the literal request.
* **Manages Complexity:** You break down ambiguous reporting requests into clear steps, including data identification, query logic, report building, QA, and delivery. You can work through complex regulatory datasets without losing accuracy or structure.
* **Decision Quality:** You use data, context, and sound judgment to validate outputs, identify anomalies, and confirm that the final result answers the question being asked. You know when to escalate unclear, incomplete, or questionable results.
* **Collaboration & Influence:** You work effectively with internal teams to clarify requests, resolve data questions, and deliver accurate customer-ready work. You communicate clearly and help keep deliverables moving without unnecessary back-and-forth.
* **Tech Savvy:** You are comfortable working with BI tools, structured data, SQL, AI-assisted tools, and analytics workflows. You learn new systems quickly and use technology to improve accuracy, speed, and quality of work.
* **Engaged:** You share our values and possess the essential competencies needed to thrive at Redica, as outlined here: https://redica.com/company

  
**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor’s degree in data analytics, business analytics, information systems, life sciences, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 1–3 years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, reporting, data operations, or a related role.
* Hands-on experience building reports, workbooks, data elements, or visualizations in a cloud BI or analytics tool, such as Sigma, Tableau, Looker, or Power BI; Sigma experience is strongly preferred.
* Working knowledge of SQL, including the ability to write, review, and troubleshoot queries against structured data.
* Experience using AI-assisted tools or natural language data interfaces to support data exploration, query development, or analysis.
* Experience producing accurate, polished work product for internal stakeholders or external customers.

  
**Additional Information**

Top Pharmaceutical Companies, Food Manufacturers, MedTech Companies, and Service Firms from around the globe rely on Redica Systems to mine and process government inspection, enforcement, and registration data. This enables them to quantify risk signals from their suppliers, identify market opportunities, benchmark against peers, and prepare for the latest inspection trends.

Our data and analytics have been cited by major media outlets, including MSNBC, *The Wall Street Journal*, and *The Boston Globe*.

jobs.description:
**Candidates must be CURRENT WI residents. No relocation allowed. This position can work 100% remote (within WI) or in the office.**

**Security Analyst I**

**Position Summary:**

We are seeking an entry-level **Security Analyst I** to support security operations by monitoring networks, systems, and cybersecurity tools. This role serves as the first line of defense in identifying potential security threats, reviewing alerts, analyzing logs, tracking vulnerabilities, and documenting security incidents. The ideal candidate is eager to build a strong foundation in threat detection, incident response, and Security Operations Center (SOC) activities.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Monitor and maintain the health of security tools, including SIEM platforms, Data Loss Prevention (DLP) solutions, and Web Application Firewalls (WAF), ensuring proper log ingestion and continuous visibility.
* Review real-time security alerts and system logs, perform initial analysis and triage, and escalate potential threats when necessary.
* Analyze vulnerability scan results and assist with tracking, reporting, and remediation efforts for identified risks.
* Document security incidents, investigations, findings, and remediation activities within the designated ticketing system.
* Escalate complex or high-priority security events to senior security personnel with clear and concise supporting documentation.
* Collaborate with IT teams, system administrators, and other stakeholders during incident investigations and resolution activities.
* Follow established security procedures and support continuous improvement of SOC operations.

**Required Qualifications:**

* Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field preferred; equivalent experience or relevant certifications will also be considered.
* Basic understanding of networking concepts and protocols, including TCP/IP, DNS, and HTTP/S.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Windows and Linux operating systems.
* Foundational knowledge of cybersecurity principles, threat detection, and incident response concepts.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
* Ability to investigate anomalies and interpret system and security logs.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills with the ability to clearly document technical information.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Exposure to SIEM, DLP, endpoint security, vulnerability management, or other cybersecurity tools.
* Relevant industry certifications such as Security+, Network+, or equivalent.
* Understanding of common cybersecurity threats, attack vectors, and best practices.

**Employment Type:**

Contract

**Experience Level:**

Entry-Level (0-2 years of cybersecurity, IT, or SOC-related experience)

**About Us:**

At Botrista, we are revolutionizing beverage culture with intuitive, Nature-guided drink-making technology. By empowering restaurants and establishments to expand their menus without added complexity, we are driving growth and innovation at the touch of a button. Awarded as one of the Best California Startups in 2023, our solutions create a new industry category, applicable to any cuisine, demographic, and business. With rapid deployment of our machines nationwide, we are delivering extraordinary beverage experiences to customers everywhere.

**Position Summary**

Botrista is seeking a highly analytical and commercially minded Revenue Operations Analyst to help us better understand what drives revenue growth, customer performance, retention, and profitability across the business.

Reporting to the Revenue Operations Manager, this role will serve as a shared analytical resource across Revenue Operations, Commercial Planning, and Finance. The Revenue Analyst will connect data across Sales, Account Management, customer performance, deployments, operations, and financial results to identify trends, explain performance, uncover opportunities and risks, and support better business decisions.

This is not simply a reporting role. We are looking for someone who is naturally curious, comfortable digging into complex data, and able to move beyond what happened to understand why it happened and what we should do about it.

The ideal candidate combines strong analytical and technical skills with commercial judgment and can translate complex analysis into clear, actionable insights for business leaders.

* Measure the downstream quality of customers acquired by Sales, including deployment, utilization, recurring revenue, retention, and expansion.
* Support deployment and revenue forecasting and analyze forecast accuracy over time.

Customer Revenue & Retention Analytics

* Analyze CSD, ingredient consumption, recurring revenue, account health, attrition, and expansion across the installed base.
* Identify leading indicators of customer growth and churn risk.
* Develop customer cohorts and account segmentation to identify which characteristics correlate with strong long-term performance.
* Analyze Account Management interventions to determine which activities actually improve customer revenue, retention, and expansion.
* Help develop data-driven account prioritization and opportunity/risk scoring.
* Quantify revenue at risk and potential revenue upside across the existing customer base.

Customer Economics & Revenue Quality

* Help develop a holistic view of customer value across the full lifecycle:

Sale Deployment Live Productive Recurring Revenue Retention Expansion

* Evaluate customer economics across verticals, deal structures, sales channels, customer profiles, and other meaningful segments.
* Partner with Finance to incorporate margin, cost, and profitability considerations into commercial analysis.
* Identify customer and program characteristics associated with higher long-term economic value.
* Help the organization move beyond measuring success solely by sales or installations toward measuring the quality and durability of revenue created.

Forecasting, Planning & Scenario Modeling

* Support commercial revenue and deployment forecasting.

* Partner with Commercial Planning and Finance on operating plans, forecasts, and scenario analysis.

**Sales Operations Analyst**

  

**Location:** Charlotte, NC (Remote)  
**Reports To:** Director of Sales Operations

**Employment Type:** Full-Time, Exempt

  

**Summary**

  

SOLID Surface Care is looking for a Sales Operations Analyst to support Salesforce, sales reporting, data analysis, and day-to-day sales operations across our growing sales organization.

  

Reporting to the Director of Sales Operations, this role will partner with Sales leadership and field sales teams to maintain accurate CRM data, analyze sales performance, improve processes, and provide operational support that helps the sales organization operate more efficiently.

  

The ideal candidate combines analytical skills with a strong understanding of business operations and customer needs. Experience in specialty floor care, commercial cleaning, restoration, or a related services industry is a plus, particularly for someone who understands how customer requirements translate into service delivery.

  

**What You'll Own**

  

**Salesforce & CRM**

* Maintain accurate account, contact, opportunity, and pipeline data in Salesforce.
* Build and maintain reports and dashboards to support sales visibility and decision-making.
* Support Salesforce configuration, workflows, automation, and troubleshooting.
* Monitor data quality, perform regular audits, and identify opportunities to improve CRM adoption and usability.
* Support Salesforce training and onboarding for new sales team members.

  

**Sales Reporting & Analysis**

* Develop recurring and ad hoc reports on pipeline, sales activity, conversion, and performance.
* Analyze sales data to identify trends, gaps, and opportunities.
* Support forecasting, territory planning, account assignments, and quota analysis.
* Translate data into actionable insights and recommendations for Sales leadership.

  

**Sales Support & Operations**

* Provide day-to-day support to sales leaders and field sales teams on Salesforce and sales processes.
* Help maintain accurate customer, opportunity, and service information to support effective handoffs between Sales and Operations.
* Partner with Sales, Finance, Marketing, and Operations to resolve data and process issues.
* Assist with RFPs, sales presentations, process improvements, and other sales initiatives.
* Support the Director of Sales Operations with special projects and the integration of new markets and acquired businesses.

  

**What We're Looking For**

  

**Required**

* 3–5 years of experience in Sales Operations, Sales Support, Business Analysis, CRM Administration, or a related role.
* Hands-on Salesforce experience, including reports, dashboards, and data management.
* Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills and the ability to analyze data and communicate meaningful insights.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills with attention to detail.
* Effective communication skills and the ability to work cross-functionally with Sales and Operations.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently in a fast-paced environment.

  

**Preferred**

* Experience in specialty floor care, commercial cleaning, restoration, facility services, or a related field-based services industry.
* Understanding of commercial customer environments, service delivery, or field operations.
* Salesforce Administrator certification or experience with Salesforce automation and integrations.
* Experience with sales forecasting, pipeline reporting, territory management, or a multi-location B2B sales organization.
* Experience in a private equity-backed, high-growth, or M&A environment.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Analytics, Finance, Operations, or a related field.

jobs.title: Program Analyst - Training Consultant
jobs.description:
Trilogy Federal drives innovative solutions for complex business challenges across financial management, healthcare, and government industries. Our collaborative, client-first service approach, combined with our commitment to the rapid implementation of pragmatic solutions, has earned Trilogy an unparalleled reputation for delivering transformative results.

Trilogy Federal seeks an Informatics Program Analyst to support a federal healthcare customer as an embedded member of a Tier 1 SME team. The role applies program and operational analysis to VHA healthcare informatics and Oracle Health/Federal EHR workflows, tracking user-support trends, adoption challenges, and training needs. The analyst coordinates site-specific support and refresher-training activities, advises on end-user resources, and uses qualitative and quantitative information to recommend workflow, program, and adoption improvements in partnership with SMEs, training stakeholders, and local sites.

### **Primary Responsibilities:**

* Analyze healthcare informatics operations, EHR workflows, user feedback, and recurring support or training gaps to identify improvements.
* Embed with Tier 1 SMEs and coordinate site-specific user-support and refresher-training requests with local contacts and training stakeholders.
* Collect, validate, and analyze qualitative and quantitative support, adoption, and program data; develop concise metrics, reports, and status updates.
* Identify recurring user issues and recommend appropriate training, coaching, job aids, communications, or workflow improvements.
* Advise SMEs and training owners on revisions to FAQs, job aids, training materials, and user guidance following system or policy changes.
* Support EHR Go-Live and Post Go-Live activities through issue tracking, program coordination, adoption monitoring, and process analysis.
* Track activities, milestones, risks, and outcomes; evaluate whether support interventions address gaps and communicate recommendations to stakeholders.

### **Minimum Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Health Informatics, Healthcare/Business Administration, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or related field
* At least 5 years of relevant clinical informatics or healthcare IT experience (Veterans Administration healthcare setting preferred)
* Experience evaluating operations or programs using qualitative and quantitative methods, analyzing data, and developing metrics, reports, and decision-support materials.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder collaboration skills.
* Ability to meet Federal/VA security, privacy, and information-security requirements, obtain a Public Trust clearance, and travel as needed.

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Oracle Health/Cerner Millennium, FEHR, VA VistA/CPRS, and VHA EHR modernization or Post Go-Live experience.
* Experience delivering or coordinating EHR workflow training, refresher sessions, workshops, office hours, coaching, and site-specific end-user support.
* Skill identifying learning needs, proficiency gaps, recurring user issues, and adoption barriers; recommending and assessing support interventions.
* Experience preparing or updating job aids, FAQs, training content, knowledge articles, and end-user communications with SMEs.
* Experience working with Tier 1 SME teams, training stakeholders, distributed sites, and change-management initiatives.
* Familiarity with dashboards, performance measurement, learning platforms, and SAFe/Agile teams.

  

### **Benefits (including but not limited to):**

* Health, dental, and vision plans
* Optional FSA
* Paid parental leave
* Safe Harbor 401(k) with employer contributions 100% vested from day 1
* Paid time off and 11 paid holidays
* No cost group term life/AD&D plan, and optional supplemental coverage
* Pet insurance
* Monthly phone and internet stipend
* Tuition and training reimbursement

$99,000 - $110,000 a year

This range is not a guarantee of compensation or salary, as Trilogy Federal conducts an individual equity review for every candidate based on experience, location, education, industry experience, and comparisons to internal pay bands. In addition to salary, Trilogy offers robust benefits including medical/dental/vision insurance coverage, 401(k) match, paid holidays, paid time off, tuition reimbursement, and a very supportive work/life balance.

**To cut down on falsified applications and to avoid subjecting real candidates to screening by AI assistants, phone interviews at Trilogy require either a landline or a cellphone number backed by a physical SIM. We cannot conduct interviews with candidates who provide VOIP contact numbers (including Google Voice).**

*Trilogy Federal is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.*

jobs.title: Cybersecurity Analyst
jobs.description:
**Company Overview**

At JRM Construction, we build more than exceptional spaces - we build talented teams, rewarding careers, and trusted relationships. As a leading employee-owned construction firm, our people take ownership of every project and work collaboratively to deliver outstanding quality and a positive client experience. Guided by integrity, teamwork, continuous improvement, and genuine care for our people, JRM provides an environment where employees can grow and help shape the company's long-term success.

**Position Overview**

We are seeking a Cybersecurity Analyst who combines a strong foundation in Windows-based IT administration with hands-on experience designing, implementing, and operating modern information security tools, alongside a governance-focused mindset. This role is critical to the success of our security operations and will play a key part in evaluating, testing, and deploying emerging technologies and new procedures, ensuring JRM remains proactive in an ever-evolving cybersecurity landscape. The ideal candidate is not only technically proficient but also highly organized, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, maintain detailed documentation, and uphold structured workflows. The Analyst also shares responsibility for incident response.

Reporting directly to the Manager of Information Security, this position offers an exciting opportunity for a security-minded technologist to thrive within a forward-thinking program that values agility, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.

**Key Responsibilities**

Governance & Risk Management:

* Assist in developing, documenting, and enforcing cybersecurity policies, standards, and control procedures.
* Support alignment with frameworks such as NIST CSF, ISO 27001, and CIS Controls.
* Maintain the security risk register and perform technical risk assessments and drive remediation to closure.

Windows IT Administration & Hardening:

* Leverage expertise in Windows Server, Active Directory, DNS, Group Policy, and PowerShell to engineer, automate, and maintain secure system baselines.
* Work with the IT and infrastructure teams to ensure secure configurations and compliance enforcement across the environment.
* Deploy, configure, and tune endpoint management and compliance controls using modern UEM, MDM, and EDR tools.

Identity Security & Access Management:

* Implement identity governance practices, privileged access controls, phishing resistant MFA, and conditional access policy design across Microsoft Entra ID and other third-party IdPs.
* Automate and improve lifecycle management processes, including secure onboarding and offboarding.

Phishing Defense & Awareness:

* Operate a phishing simulation and security awareness platform, run phishing simulations, and report on campaign effectiveness.
* Triage user-reported phishing attempts and maintain IT communication templates and user education content.

Security Engineering & Tooling:

* Design, deploy, and maintain core security platforms, including EDR, SIEM, email security, and vulnerability management.
* Maintain configuration baselines and documentation for deployed security tools.
* Integrate security tools with Microsoft 365, Entra ID, and the broader IT environment to improve visibility and reduce manual effort.
* Run vulnerability scanning, prioritize findings by risk, and coordinate remediation with IT and infrastructure teams.

Detection, Incident Response & Automation:

* Monitor SIEM alerts and dashboards, and tune detections to reduce noise.
* Act as a technical responder in security incidents: triage, investigate, contain, and document root cause and lessons learned.
* Support incident response playbooks and tabletop exercises.
* Automate repetitive security tasks and response workflows using PowerShell, Python, and SOAR or automation platforms.

Innovation & Emerging Technology Evaluation:

* Participate in research, testing, and proof-of-concept (PoC) efforts for new cybersecurity tools, technologies, and frameworks.
* Deploy new technologies and procedures that improve detection, prevention, and governance.
* Provide technical input and analysis for tool evaluations, pilots, and strategic initiatives.

**Qualifications**

Required:

* 3+ years of experience in IT administration, systems engineering, or information security, with a strong focus on Windows environments.
* Familiarity with Microsoft 365, Entra ID (Azure AD), third-party IDP providers, Intune, and modern endpoint security tools.
* Scripting and automation skills in PowerShell.
* Understanding of cybersecurity frameworks and governance models (NIST CSF, ISO 27001, CIS).
* Analytical, collaborative, and adaptable mindset with strong documentation skills.

Preferred:

* Hands-on experience deploying, configuring, and tuning security tools such as EDR, email security, and vulnerability management platforms, or evaluating emerging and cloud security solutions.
* Exposure to SIEM detection engineering and SOAR or automation platforms.
* Experience in risk assessments, audit preparation, or compliance reporting.
* Familiarity with Python, SQL, or Bash/Shell for automation and security analysis.

**Salary Information**  
To the extent this position is performed in New York City, the annual salary range for this role is $90,000 - $110,000.

*All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment at JRM without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other characteristics protected by law.*

  

*The salary range listed in job postings reflects the Company's good-faith estimate at the time of posting. Actual compensation may vary based on factors such as position tier, geographic location, work experience, market conditions, education/training, and skills.*

jobs.title: Deployment Strategist (Cleared)
jobs.description:
Government technology has failed citizens, veterans, public servants, and service members for decades.

Kaizen powers America’s application layer. We replace the legacy systems federal agencies run on with modern software, built with craft. The ticketing platform a resident uses to visit a presidential library. The marketplace DoW uses to procure counter-drone systems to protect lives and critical infrastructure. The system a Veteran uses to access benefits. We build systems of record, of national consequence. Our AI-native modules and harness allow us to do so in weeks, not years.

This year, our revenue has grown 35x. Next year, our software will serve over 100 million Americans across dozens of federal agencies.

Founded in 2022 and based in New York City and DC, Kaizen has raised $35 million from NEA, a16z, Accel, 776, and Carpenter Capital.

**Location**
------------

This is a hybrid role based out of our New York or DC. Candidates must reside in New York or DC and be able to commute to work out of our office at least four times a week (Monday - Thursday).

**Clearance and Eligibility**
-----------------------------

This role requires an active Top Secret or TS/SCI clearance. United States citizenship is required, because it is a condition of eligibility for the clearance the role depends on.

**The Role**
------------

You'll own the full implementation journey for Kaizen's federal customers: scoping the rollout, configuring the platform, training agency staff, and staying in the room until the deployment is actually adopted, not just launched. You'll work inside classified and accredited environments where every integration decision has to account for what data can move where, and you'll partner closely with the engineering team to make sure what gets shipped actually fits how the agency operates.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Own end-to-end federal implementations: discovery, scoping, configuration, data migration, integrations, training, go-live, and post-launch support.
* Lead onboarding for agency stakeholders and career staff, translating what they actually need into a rollout plan that survives contact with a live agency.
* Work inside classification and data-handling constraints as a design input, not an obstacle, coordinating closely with engineering on what can be built and how.
* Translate patterns from the field back to Product and Engineering: edge cases, workflow gaps, and the things agencies never put in the RFP but need on day one.
* Act as the connective tissue between customer-facing implementation and the engineers building, so what ships matches what was promised.
* Build the playbooks, templates, and internal documentation that make the next federal deployment faster than this one.
* Guide public sector partners through the actual change management of replacing a legacy system, not just the technical cutover.

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

* 3+ years in SaaS implementation, onboarding, solutions engineering, or a product-adjacent delivery role (Implementation Consultant, Solutions Architect, Technical Program Manager), with a track record of owning multi-stakeholder rollouts.
* Technical fluency: comfortable working with APIs, data models, and system configurations, and able to hold your own in a conversation with engineers about integration tradeoffs.
* Experience translating customer requirements into implementation plans and technical workflows, not just a status tracker.
* Comfort operating inside classified or otherwise accredited environments, or a clear ability to pick up new compliance and data-handling constraints fast.
* A bias toward action: you'd rather build the process while running the deployment than wait for someone to hand you one.

**Strong Candidates May Also...**
---------------------------------

* Have deployed software inside a classified or accredited environment before and know where the real friction lives.
* Have touched federal, state, or local government implementation work specifically, versus enterprise SaaS generally.
* Have built implementation playbooks or internal tooling from scratch at an early-stage company.

**Don't Apply If...**
---------------------

* You need a mature playbook to follow. Most of what you'll use here, you'll be building.
* You want to hand off the hard technical questions to engineering and stay on the process side. This role lives at that intersection.
* You're looking for a steady-state customer success role. This is deployment under real constraints, with real agencies, and real consequences if it goes wrong.
* Government bureaucracy and slow-moving stakeholders would wear you down instead of something you know how to work with.
* The agencies you'll be deploying to serve people who don't have another option if the system doesn't work. That's the weight of this one.

**What Kaizen Offers**
----------------------

**Health & Insurance**

* 100% coverage across the board: medical through Oxford/United (Gold and Platinum PPO plans), dental through Guardian PPO, and vision through Beam — all fully covered for employees, with 100% coverage for dependents.
* $100,000 in fully paid life insurance. FSA and Dependent Care FSA.
* One Medical membership, on us — same-day primary care, 24/7 virtual visits, and offices all over the city.
* Fertility and family-building support through Carrot.
* 401(k) through Guideline, with a 2% company match.

**Family & Time Off**

* 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave for birthing parents. 10 weeks fully paid for non-birthing parents.
* Unlimited PTO, with a two-week minimum (we mean it when we say take time off!)
* Closed for all federal holidays.
* Company-wide winter break the week of Christmas.
* Company offsites throughout the year.

**Office & Remote Setup**

* Up to $750 one-time home office or desk setup stipend for NYC-based employees. $500 for remote employees.
* $50/month commuter benefit (company contribution).
* Expensed lunch whil

New York, United States of America | Full time | Home-based | R1575004

  

The Project Manager, MedSurg Professional Services & Customer Success, serves as the primary point of accountability for internal and external stakeholders across customer-facing Endoscopy digital implementation projects. Success in this role requires the ability to lead complex, multi-dimensional projects; translate clinical and technical requirements into executable plans; influence without direct authority; identify and resolve risks early; and maintain customer confidence throughout the implementation lifecycle.

  
  

**Job Responsibilities:**
-------------------------

  
  

**Project leadership and accountability**

* Own delivery of assigned Endoscopy digital implementation projects from intake through closure, ensuring alignment to scope, schedule, quality, customer adoption, and measurable outcomes.
* Develop and maintain comprehensive project plans, workstream schedules, milestone plans, RAID logs, decision logs, communication plans, and status reports.
* Lead project kickoffs, governance meetings, technical and clinical workstream meetings, milestone reviews, go-live readiness reviews, and project closeout activities.
* Serve as the primary liaison among customers, internal project teams, sales, clinical product specialists, service engineers, customer success, vendors, and line management.
  

  

**Endoscopy implementation delivery**

* Plan and coordinate implementation activities for Endoscopy medical-device systems, including equipment, workstations, software, network products, and related hospital infrastructure.
* Partner with customer IT, clinical engineering, endoscopy leadership, facility teams, and Client technical resources to confirm site readiness, technical requirements, access, connectivity, configuration, and deployment sequencing.
* Coordinate equipment setup, organization, installation, configuration, testing, updates, and readiness activities in accordance with approved procedures and customer requirements.
* Guide project activities through planning, implementation, training, go-live, stabilization, adoption, and closure while maintaining clear ownership of next steps and acceptance criteria.
  

  

**Risk, issue, quality, and escalation management**

* Proactively identify and manage risks across scope, schedule, cost, technical readiness, clinical workflow, adoption, quality, security, and customer satisfaction.
* Identify, prioritize, and resolve project issues promptly; escalate critical risks, issues, and decisions through the appropriate governance structure.
* Ensure customer complaints or concerns are documented, routed, and escalated in accordance with Client complaint-handling, quality, and service procedures.
* Promote safe, consistent, and repeatable implementation practices across customer sites and project teams.
  

  

**Stakeholder engagement and communication**

* Build effective working relationships with internal and external customers, including technical, clinical, operational, executive, and vendor stakeholders.
* Translate complex technical and clinical information into clear decisions, actions, status updates, and recommendations for different audiences.
* Facilitate alignment among stakeholders with competing priorities and influence outcomes without direct authority.
* Maintain customer confidence by setting expectations clearly, communicating proactively, and following through on commitments.
  

  

**Differentiating factors**

* **Autonomy:** Operates independently with minimal supervision and determines effective approaches to complex implementation challenges.
* **Organizational impact:** Drives the success of significant customer projects and processes while building consensus across functions and organizations.
* **Innovation and complexity:** Solves multi-dimensional problems spanning clinical workflows, technical infrastructure, medical devices, software, customer adoption, and operational readiness.
* **Communication and influence:** Engages effectively with hospital leaders, customer executives, technical and clinical teams, vendors, and Client leadership to negotiate outcomes and support informed decisions.
  

  

**Schedule:**
-------------

* Ability to travel to customer sites as required; travel will vary by project phase and customer needs. This is a home-based role with travel as needed. Demonstrated ability to work independently and collaboratively is a necessity in prior experience.
* This role may require onsite work in hospitals and customer facilities, including equipment setup, implementation support, training, verification activities, and go-live support.
* Expected schedule for this role is 40 hours per week.
  

  

**Required Qualifications:**
----------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in business, healthcare, information technology, engineering, clinical sciences, or related fields. Other education and combination of experience in lieu of a Bachelor's degree will be considered in similar roles.
* Minimum of 3 years of experience in healthcare IT, medical-device implementation, SaaS implementation, professional services, consulting, or related project management work.
* Experience leading complex customer-facing projects involving multiple technical, clinical, operational, or vendor workstreams.
* Demonstrated experience developing project plans, managing scope and schedule, coordinating stakeholders, tracking risks and issues, and reporting project status.

* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, judgment, urgency, and ability to manage competing priorities.

jobs.description:
**The Company:**
----------------

At **impact.com** our culture is our soul. We are passionate about our people, our technology, and are obsessed with customer success. Working together enables us to grow rapidly, win, and serve the largest brands in the world. We use cutting edge technology to solve real-world problems for our clients and continue to pull ahead of the pack as the leading SaaS platform for businesses to automate their partnerships and grow their revenue like never before. We have an entrepreneurial spirit and a culture where ambition and curiosity is rewarded. If you are looking to join a team where your opinion is valued, your contributions are noticed, and enjoy working with fun and talented people from all over the world, then this is the place for you!

**impact.com**, the world's leading partnership management platform, is transforming the way businesses manage and optimize all types of partnerships—including traditional rewards affiliates, influencers, commerce content publishers, B2B, and more. The company's powerful, purpose-built platform makes it easy for businesses to create, manage, and scale an ecosystem of partnerships with the brands and communities that customers trust to make purchases, get information, and entertain themselves at home, at work, or on the go. To learn more about how **impact.com**'s technology platform and partnerships marketplace is driving revenue growth for global enterprise brands such as Walmart, Uber, Shopify, Lenovo, and Fanatics visit www.impact.com.

jobs.description:
Thanks for your interest in Success Academy! Running a large, fast-growing, and high-performing network of public charter schools takes a village - families, children, teachers, staff and faculty, advocates, and supporters alike. We are growing fast in New York and expanding to Florida, and we would love to welcome you to our community! We work tirelessly every day to ensure children have access to a fun, rigorous, whole-child education regardless of zip code or economic status. When you join SA, you play a part in giving every student who walks through our doors a fair shot at reaching his or her potential.

**About the Role**

Success Academy is growing rapidly and security is at the forefront of enabling that growth. We are seeking a Security Analyst to join our Information Security & Privacy team. This individual will play a critical role in building, strengthening, and operationalizing our security programs. This is a unique opportunity to make an immediate and lasting impact, addressing the unique needs of a K-12 school environment.

  

The Security Analyst will be hands-on across multiple domains, including security operations, endpoint protection, cloud security, data loss prevention, compliance, and privacy, and partner closely with the Technology Operations team on security change management across the organization.

  

This role reports into the head of Security & Privacy and sits within the Technology department. The Technology team manages a modern technology environment built around cloud and SaaS based applications, operates networking and in-school technologies across 57 school locations, and supports managed devices used by over 3,000 employees and over 20,000 students. This position will be based in the network office (3-days a week onsite) in Manhattan (10005).

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Incident Response: use our SIEM to identify vulnerabilities, investigate alerts, and lead incident response & remediation efforts
* Email Security: Support existing efforts to build email compliance and DLP rules, and take proactive measures against advanced phishing techniques
* Security Operations: Partner with IT, engineering, and business stakeholders to ensure security is integrated into workflows across the organization
* Program Building: Lead implementation of scalable security processes across incident response, access management, vulnerability management, and DLP
* Cloud Security: Support security for AWS and GCP environments, working closely with cloud engineering teams to resolve vulnerabilities
* Security Tooling: Stay ahead of emerging threats and security trends, recommend and vet new tools as appropriate

  

**Qualifications**

* 3+ years of professional experience in information security roles within technology-driven organizations
* Strong hands-on experience with security incident response workflows using a SIEM
* Experience with Crowdstrike Falcon or similar endpoint security platforms
* Expertise in Google Workspace security administration (Gmail rules, DLP, monitoring)
* Expertise in advanced email security platforms (Sublime, Mimecast, Proofpoint, Abnormal, etc.)
* Expertise with identity access management platforms (Okta)
* Knowledgeable in AWS and GCP infrastructure implementation, security controls, IAM, and monitoring, as well as Wiz
* Familiarity with security frameworks and privacy regulations (SOC 2, ISO 27001, FERPA)
* Ability to work hybrid onsite at Manhattan (10005) headquarters Tuesday through Thursday

  

**Competencies**

* Meticulous and tenacious mindset in identifying and resolving security risks
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to convey security concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

* **Time to Recharge:** Generous paid time off, paid holidays, and paid parental leave.
* **Perks & Stipends:** A $50/month cellphone stipend ($600/year), pre-tax commuter benefits, backup family care, and performance-based earning incentives.

This is a hybrid position based in our NYC Financial District office, requiring on-site work Tuesday through Thursday and remote work on Monday and Friday.

jobs.title: Junior Business Analyst (Data & Integration)
jobs.description:
##### **About Peraton**

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

##### **Program Overview**

The program is an IDIQ contract for an AWS-based cloud hosting system. Currently, Peraton is supporting the Cloud Security, IoT, and AIML use cases for the environment in a hybrid work environment with Federal employees. Peraton also support the following applications as part of the environment: Dremio, Tableau, Globus, Posit/RStudio, Atlassian, ThingLogix, Alteryx and CloudCheckr.

##### **About The Role**

  

Peraton is seeking a **Junior Business Analyst** **(Data & Integration)** with a strong data analysis background to support NOAA Fisheries data mapping, interoperability requirements, and compliance documentation on a federal data integration program. This role focuses on the technical business analysis activities that bridge data engineering and regulatory compliance.

  

The Department of the Interior (DOI), U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service (FWS), and NOAA's National Marine Fisheries Service (NMFS) have identified a critical gap in the federal government's ability to conduct comprehensive Endangered Species Act (ESA) research. While FWS operates an authoritative web-based platform for managing data for terrestrial and freshwater species, it does not currently include NMFS marine and anadromous species data forcing agencies to rely on separate, manual processes. This program closes that gap by integrating marine and anadromous species data into the existing FWS platform, creating a single, unified experience for all ESA-listed species.

  

**Work Location:** Remote

  

**Day to Day Responsibilities:**

* Conduct detailed source-to-target data mapping analysis for NOAA Fisheries species datasets, documenting field-level transformation rules, data type conversions, and null-handling logic.
* Analyze NOAA Fisheries data quality issues identified during prototype ingestion and document remediation requirements.
* Support the Metadata and Authoritative Source Registry by researching and documenting NOAA Fisheries data source attributes, refresh cadences, and data stewardship contacts.
* Assist in the development and documentation of interoperability testing requirements including API connectivity, data exchange protocols, and metadata alignment test cases.
* Support compliance validation checklist development by documenting validation criteria for species list generation, decision logic, and template content completeness.
* Analyze live consultation feedback from production and document actionable requirements for system updates.
* Support the Prototype Ingest Results Report by documenting NOAA Fisheries data quality issues identified during prototype ingestion, including defect descriptions, root cause analysis, and remediation requirements.
* Assist in the development of training metrics dashboard requirements and reporting specifications.
* Support the compilation of final operational documentation by documenting NOAA Fisheries data refresh procedures.

##### **Qualifications**

  

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree with 0 years of professional experience, or a Master’s degree with 0 years of professional experience, or an Associate’s degree with 2 years of professional experience, or a high school diploma/equivalent with 4 years of professional experience.
* U.S. Citizenship required; must have the ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance; all work must be performed within the United States.
* Experience supporting business analysis experience with a focus on data integration or data migration programs.
* Experience with source-to-target data mapping and data quality analysis.
* Familiarity with API integration concepts and interoperability testing requirements.
* Strong analytical and technical documentation skills.
* Experience supporting federal IT programs.
  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with NOAA Fisheries or other federal environmental data systems.
* Familiarity with ETL concepts, data pipelines, or cloud data platforms.
* Experience supporting compliance validation activities on federal programs.
* Experience contributing to program status reports or monthly progress reports.
* ECBA or CCBA certification.

##### **Details**

**Target Salary Range:** $51,000 - $82,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

**Benefits Statement:** Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at https://www.careers.peraton.com/benefits.

**Application Statements:** The application period for the job is estimated to be 30 days from the job posting

jobs.description:
Reporting to the Director of Data Strategy & Analytics, the **Finance Transformation Project Manager** works across four primary areas — Accounting, Financial Operations, Financial Systems, and Data Strategy & Analytics — as well as other business and technology teams as needed. The role builds relationships across these areas, identifies opportunities for improvement, connects the right people and capabilities, and coordinates initiatives that span organizational boundaries. The Chief Financial Officer serves as executive sponsor for the broader Finance transformation portfolio.

This role is expected to operate with a high degree of initiative, curiosity, independence, and judgment. The Director of Data Strategy & Analytics provides leadership, coaching, and guidance, while the Project Manager is expected to take ownership of navigating the organization and moving initiatives forward.

Success requires exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, structured problem solving, sound judgment, organizational awareness, and the ability to influence and create momentum without relying on formal authority. jobs.title: Deployment Strategist (Cleared)
jobs.description:
Government technology has failed citizens, veterans, public servants, and service members for decades.

Kaizen powers America’s application layer. We replace the legacy systems federal agencies run on with modern software, built with craft. The ticketing platform a resident uses to visit a presidential library. The marketplace DoW uses to procure counter-drone systems to protect lives and critical infrastructure. The system a Veteran uses to access benefits. We build systems of record, of national consequence. Our AI-native modules and harness allow us to do so in weeks, not years.

This year, our revenue has grown 35x. Next year, our software will serve over 100 million Americans across dozens of federal agencies.

Founded in 2022 and based in New York City and DC, Kaizen has raised $35 million from NEA, a16z, Accel, 776, and Carpenter Capital.

**Location**
------------

This is a hybrid role based out of our New York or DC. Candidates must reside in New York or DC and be able to commute to work out of our office at least four times a week (Monday - Thursday).

**Clearance and Eligibility**
-----------------------------

This role requires an active Top Secret or TS/SCI clearance. United States citizenship is required, because it is a condition of eligibility for the clearance the role depends on.

**The Role**
------------

You'll own the full implementation journey for Kaizen's federal customers: scoping the rollout, configuring the platform, training agency staff, and staying in the room until the deployment is actually adopted, not just launched. You'll work inside classified and accredited environments where every integration decision has to account for what data can move where, and you'll partner closely with the engineering team to make sure what gets shipped actually fits how the agency operates.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* Own end-to-end federal implementations: discovery, scoping, configuration, data migration, integrations, training, go-live, and post-launch support.
* Lead onboarding for agency stakeholders and career staff, translating what they actually need into a rollout plan that survives contact with a live agency.
* Work inside classification and data-handling constraints as a design input, not an obstacle, coordinating closely with engineering on what can be built and how.
* Translate patterns from the field back to Product and Engineering: edge cases, workflow gaps, and the things agencies never put in the RFP but need on day one.
* Act as the connective tissue between customer-facing implementation and the engineers building, so what ships matches what was promised.
* Build the playbooks, templates, and internal documentation that make the next federal deployment faster than this one.
* Guide public sector partners through the actual change management of replacing a legacy system, not just the technical cutover.

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

* 3+ years in SaaS implementation, onboarding, solutions engineering, or a product-adjacent delivery role (Implementation Consultant, Solutions Architect, Technical Program Manager), with a track record of owning multi-stakeholder rollouts.
* Technical fluency: comfortable working with APIs, data models, and system configurations, and able to hold your own in a conversation with engineers about integration tradeoffs.
* Experience translating customer requirements into implementation plans and technical workflows, not just a status tracker.
* Comfort operating inside classified or otherwise accredited environments, or a clear ability to pick up new compliance and data-handling constraints fast.
* A bias toward action: you'd rather build the process while running the deployment than wait for someone to hand you one.

**Strong Candidates May Also...**
---------------------------------

* Have deployed software inside a classified or accredited environment before and know where the real friction lives.
* Have touched federal, state, or local government implementation work specifically, versus enterprise SaaS generally.
* Have built implementation playbooks or internal tooling from scratch at an early-stage company.

**Don't Apply If...**
---------------------

* You need a mature playbook to follow. Most of what you'll use here, you'll be building.
* You want to hand off the hard technical questions to engineering and stay on the process side. This role lives at that intersection.
* You're looking for a steady-state customer success role. This is deployment under real constraints, with real agencies, and real consequences if it goes wrong.
* Government bureaucracy and slow-moving stakeholders would wear you down instead of something you know how to work with.
* The agencies you'll be deploying to serve people who don't have another option if the system doesn't work. That's the weight of this one.

**What Kaizen Offers**
----------------------

**Health & Insurance**

* 100% coverage across the board: medical through Oxford/United (Gold and Platinum PPO plans), dental through Guardian PPO, and vision through Beam — all fully covered for employees, with 100% coverage for dependents.
* $100,000 in fully paid life insurance. FSA and Dependent Care FSA.
* One Medical membership, on us — same-day primary care, 24/7 virtual visits, and offices all over the city.
* Fertility and family-building support through Carrot.
* 401(k) through Guideline, with a 2% company match.

**Family & Time Off**

* 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave for birthing parents. 10 weeks fully paid for non-birthing parents.
* Unlimited PTO, with a two-week minimum (we mean it when we say take time off!)
* Closed for all federal holidays.
* Company-wide winter break the week of Christmas.
* Company offsites throughout the year.

**Office & Remote Setup**

* Up to $750 one-time home office or desk setup stipend for NYC-based employees. $500 for remote employees.
* $50/month commuter benefit (company contribution).
* Expensed lunch whil

jobs.title: Technical Project Manager, Site Deployment - Electrical Design Assurance, NA
jobs.description:
**About Vantage**
=================

Vantage powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands.

**Reliability Engineering**

The Reliability Engineering Department is responsible for ensuring the operational health of critical systems and the implementation of Site Operations best practices. This includes evaluating the performance and reliability of critical infrastructure, maintaining operational availability through maintenance programs, and providing technical support to Site Operations teams. The department also collaborates closely with the Design Engineering team to provide feedback for future data center designs.

**Position Overview**

**This role will be based near any of our North America office locations, following our flexible work policy (3 days in-office and 2 days flexible).**

The Sr. Technical Project Manager, Site Deployment - Electrical Design Assurance is responsible for providing operationally focused electrical review and technical assurance for new data center builds, expansions, and major fit-out projects across the North America portfolio. This role represents Site Operations and Site Deployment during design development, page-turn reviews, submittal reviews, RFI responses, commissioning strategy alignment, and movement of design packages toward Issued for Construction drawings.

The position ensures that electrical systems are designed and delivered in a manner that is operable, maintainable, safe, reliable, and aligned with long-term Mission Critical Operations requirements. Working closely with Design Engineering, Construction, Commissioning, Business Operations, and local Site Operations teams, this role brings operator perspective into electrical design decisions before construction execution, procurement, and turnover activities create downstream operational risk.

**Essential Job Functions**

* Serve as the primary Site Deployment representative for electrical design assurance across assigned campuses, projects, and expansions.
* Participate in design page-turn reviews and provide operator-focused comments from concept design through IFC drawing issuance.
* Review electrical design packages, one-line diagrams, specifications, sequences of operation, equipment schedules, load studies, and drawing sets for operability, maintainability, safety, and reliability.
* Review electrical submittals, equipment selections, vendor documentation, and proposed alternates to evaluate operational impact, maintainability requirements, protection strategy, and lifecycle risk.
